export.mapping: All DIMACS ids have c-line labels; all 5695 source labels are present. The generated label at-least repeats on 4080 auxiliary ids, so the integer id is the canonical auxiliary identity.

comparison.conclusion: The PB-to-CNF transformation is fast, but bounded CaDiCaL runs also return UNKNOWN. No material outer-solve improvement or mathematical result was demonstrated.

trust_boundary: The smoke tests validate only small representative PB formulas.
Z3 4.16 tactic translation from the hash-pinned source formula is not independently certified.
A verified DRAT would certify only the emitted DIMACS CNF; the timed-out DRAT stream is incomplete and is not a proof.
No SAT assignment was produced, so source-formula readback did not run.
The source model is bounded to n=17 and omits Euclidean realizability constraints.
The live Lean obligation has n>=17, so even fixed-n UNSAT would not close it.
